amount.description: The cost of changing the date of the conversion.

currency.description: The currency of the cost to change the conversion date. A three-letter ISO currency code.

new_conversion_date.description: The new date the conversion will be made.

new_settlement_date.description: The new date and time by which funds need to be available to settle the trade.

old_conversion_date.description: The previous date the conversion was to be made.

old_settlement_date.description: The previous date and time by which funds needed to be available to settle the trade.

event_date_time.description: The date and time of the date change or date change quote.
